description: The same two-entry directory at maximumDiscoveryEntries 1. The OTHER half of what :1247's javadoc promises: the child directory is skipped AND still charges the discovery budget, so a two-entry directory refuses at 1 where it loads at 2. A port that skipped child directories before charging passes the sibling case and fails this one. The child's NAME is load-bearing: a first draft named it 'child', which the filename-to-tag test silently skips anyway, so ablating the directory skip changed nothing and the case was vacuous. Named de.json, the directory skip is the ONLY thing that skips it -- without it the walk reaches the not-a-regular-file guard instead.
